name: TotalSegmentator
author: Jakob Wasserthal et al. (University Hospital Basel)
description: Automatic segmentation of 117 anatomical structures in CT and MR images using nnU-Net models. Cite: https://pubs.rsna.org/doi/10.1148/ryai.230024

segmentationTasks.name: Total (104 structures, CT)
segmentationTasks.description: Full-body CT segmentation: organs, vertebrae, ribs, muscles, vessels at 1.5 mm resolution.

segmentationTasks.name: Total Fast (104 structures, CT, 3 mm)
segmentationTasks.description: Same classes as 'total' but at 3 mm resolution — faster, lower memory.

segmentationTasks.name: Total MR (104 structures)
segmentationTasks.description: Full-body MR segmentation at 1.5 mm resolution.

segmentationTasks.name: Lung Vessels
segmentationTasks.description: Lung airways, airway walls, arteries, and veins.

segmentationTasks.name: Tissue Types
segmentationTasks.description: Subcutaneous fat, muscle, visceral fat, bone, etc.

segmentationTasks.name: Body Region
segmentationTasks.description: Body trunk and extremity segmentation (used for cropping).
